summary: Completed end-to-end testing of ProClinic MVP (FastAPI + React + MongoDB). 19/19 backend pytest pass (100%). Frontend critical flows all working: login (right/wrong pw), JWT cookie + token, dashboard KPIs/cards, patients list+search+modal+detail tabs, agenda weekly view with seeded appointments, financeiro summary, AI Assistant chat with Claude 4.5 reply, theme toggle (light→dark), logout, protected route redirect, Google session 400 validation. Minor UX/design issues only — no blockers.

minor.issue: allow_origins=['*'] combined with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per spec (browsers can reject cookies for credentialed cross-origin requests). Works in current preview because samesite=none+secure but should be tightened to explicit origin list using FRONTEND_URL env in production.

Chart month buckets are computed as (today - i*30 days) which can produce duplicate or skipped months around month boundaries (e.g. response showed two 2026-01 entries). Use calendar-month arithmetic instead.

ui_bugs.issue: Form inputs (nome, cpf, telefone, email, etc.) lack data-testid and name attributes, making granular automated testing difficult. Add data-testid like 'patient-name-input', 'patient-cpf-input' etc.

Console warnings 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — ResponsiveContainer has no minHeight/minWidth so first paint is invalid. Add minHeight to ResponsiveContainer parent or set aspect ratio.
Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby — a11y warning in console. Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby={undefined} attribute suppression.
Native browser date picker rendered as 'mm/dd/yyyy' (US locale, against pt-BR target). Replace with shadcn Calendar/DatePicker or set lang='pt-BR'.

issues: Visual is premium and on-brand (rose gold + champagne). Looks excellent.
Word 'Saldo' not surfaced as plain text in body (likely rendered inside chart legend only). Consider adding a 'Saldo do mês' KPI card alongside Receitas/Despesas for parity with PRD.

action_items: Add data-testid attributes to inputs inside Novo Paciente / Novo Atendimento modals to enable field-level e2e testing.
Add minHeight to recharts ResponsiveContainer wrappers in Dashboard.jsx and Financeiro.jsx to remove width(-1)/height(-1) warning on first paint.
Add <DialogDescription> (or aria-describedby) inside Radix DialogContent components to satisfy a11y.
Switch date inputs from native <input type='date'> to a localized shadcn DatePicker (pt-BR dd/mm/yyyy).
Tighten CORS allow_origins in /app/backend/server.py to use FRONTEND_URL env var (with credentials=True).
Fix /api/finance/summary chart month iteration to use calendar months (avoid 30-day arithmetic duplicates near month boundaries).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 935 lines — recommend splitting into routers/ (auth.py, patients.py, appointments.py, finance.py, ai.py) and models.py for maintainability.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True is a known spec violation; works in preview but is fragile.
finance_summary chart month computation uses i*30 days — can produce duplicate buckets (observed 2026-01 twice).
seed_data() runs on every startup — safe due to count checks, but consider an env flag SEED_ENABLE for production deployments.
Cookie set with secure=True samesite=none requires HTTPS — correct for preview, but local dev (http) would fail silently. Document this or branch by env.
